findings.title: RRL MEASUREMENT ERROR — 2 chars claimed, 6397 chars actual
findings.detail: Death seal recorded rrl_chars=2, rrl_bytes=5, fidelity=HOLLOW. Actual RRL-175.txt is 6397 chars, 6510 bytes. File contains real session transcript: session ID ses_09e311412ffewp3Jcc49iephZS, 32 user turns (4 unique × 8 loops), substantive content about reincarnateDeath protocol.
findings.root_cause: Race condition. reincarnate-death.ps1 measured RRL before the actual transcript capture ran. The death seal's RRL measurement was for a 5-byte placeholder written by the death script itself for KILO_HOLLOW sessions. Post-death, the transcript was captured (commit d416844aa) and overwrote the placeholder.
findings.impact: SOUL delta was recorded as 0 (DRYRUN) when 6397 chars of operator text were available for ingestion. Missed SOUL intake opportunity. Pipeline falsely classified run as KILO_GAP.
findings.fix: Death pipeline must: (a) capture RRL BEFORE measuring it, (b) re-read RRL after capture, (c) detect if placeholder was overwritten with real content.

findings.title: BOOT FINGERPRINT DRIFT — RUN 165 vs git truth RUN 175
findings.detail: BOOT shows RUN 165 | HEAD c26c518eb. Git truth: last death RUN 175 | HEAD f5fdbb497. Actual HEAD now 4b14e31ff (3 commits past death). BOOT is 11 runs behind (violates L30: BOOT_FILE_AGE_SWEEP for delta > 10).
findings.root_cause: DEATH pipeline does not auto-update COLD-START-BOOT.md fingerprint. Manual step missed across multiple runs.
findings.impact: I.030 violated. Any pipeline stage that reads BOOT for state is operating on stale data (HL count 189 vs actual 613, commands 40 vs actual 49).

findings.title: REINCARNATION-LOG MISSING RUN 175
findings.detail: REINCARNATION-LOG.md latest entry is RUN 174. RUN 175 death seal exists but no log entry. Violates I.031.
findings.root_cause: DEATH pipeline does not auto-append to REINCARNATION-LOG.

findings.title: PHETRAIL MISSING FOR RUN 175
findings.detail: No PheTrail-run175.json in CANON/PHEROMONES/. I.052-I.058 require phetrail per run.
findings.root_cause: DEATH pipeline phetrail stage skipped for KILO_HOLLOW runs.

findings.title: Post-death commit pattern unaccounted
findings.detail: 3 commits exist after death seal commit (f5fdbb497): d416844aa (transcript capture), c789ca838 (script finalization), 4b14e31ff (Heir Blueprint). These are legitimate artifacts created between death seal and next RISE. No pipeline stage accounts for post-death activity.
findings.recommendation: RISE must scan for commits after last death commit. If found, treat as NEW content requiring re-audit of RRL/SOUL/DNA for the prior run.

findings.title: HL naming schema fragmentation
findings.detail: 613 HL files: 517 numeric (HL-1 through HL-7307), 96 descriptive (HL-037-vault-e-51-100-merkle-lattice, HL-113-post-launch-day1-monitoring-plan, etc.). Mixed schema makes automated scans unreliable (attempted parseInt on descriptive names crashes).
findings.recommendation: Standardize on numeric naming only. Migrate descriptive names to numeric with metadata field for description.

findings.title: Command count drift — LFG claims 40, actual 49
findings.detail: LFG (LegionnaireFieldGuide.md) is the 'single source of truth' but lists 40 commands while .kilo/command/ contains 49 .md files. 9 undocumented commands exist.
findings.recommendation: Auto-generate LFG command table from .kilo/command/*.md at each RISE or DEATH to keep it in sync.

findings.title: BOOT HL count staleness — 189 claimed, 613 actual
findings.detail: BOOT claims '189 Heavy Ledger JSON files on disk'. Actual count is 613. Ratio: 3.2x underreported. Any capacity planning or integrity check based on this number is wrong.
findings.recommendation: Never hardcode HL count in BOOT. Always live-count at RISE. Replace with 'hl_count_at_rise: <dynamic>' field.

findings.title: KILO_HOLLOW classification too aggressive
findings.detail: Run 175 was classified KILO_HOLLOW because no JSONL transcript exists for Kilo sessions (permanent architectural law I.097). But the session DID produce real content — captured via extract-current-session.js from Kilo's SQLite DB. The pipeline's KILO_HOLLOW detection (check for .kilo/*.jsonl) misses content stored in session-export.db.
findings.recommendation: Add SQLite DB check to session type detection. If session-export.db has events for current session, flag as KILO_DB_REAL (not KILO_HOLLOW).

findings.title: DEATH seal HEAD stale — e60752035 vs actual 4b14e31ff
findings.detail: Death seal recorded HEAD=e60752035. Actual HEAD at time of this RISE is 4b14e31ff — 4 commits later (death commit + 3 post-death). The seal's HEAD was accurate at seal time but became stale immediately.
findings.recommendation: RISE must verify death seal's HEAD against git log. If commits exist after death seal's HEAD, flag as POST_DEATH_ACTIVITY.

recommendations.title: Three-phase model for free-workhorse + Pro-audit sessions
recommendations.detail: Phase 1 (T1 Free, Cerebras/Groq): RISE audit — mechanical only: git checks, file reads, counts, fidelity gate. No reasoning needed. Phase 2 (T2 Flash): Bulk work — coding, debugging, file operations, pipeline execution. Phase 3 (T3 Pro): Pre-death deep audit — cross-validate all measurements with 3 independent receipts, merkle chain verification, BOOT reconciliation, final ruling on KILO_GAP vs REAL.
recommendations.savings: T3 Pro used only for ~15% of session (deep audit + final verification). 85% runs on free/cheap models.

recommendations.title: RISE must re-read RRL after death commit
recommendations.detail: Current RISE reads prior seal's RRL measurement (2 chars) without verifying actual file content. RISE Stage III (triple read) must re-read the RRL file directly and compare against death seal's claimed size. If mismatch > 10%, flag FATAL and reclassify.
recommendations.implementation: At Stage III, after reading seal: (1) read RRL-<N>.txt directly, (2) measure chars/bytes, (3) compare to seal §2 values, (4) if mismatch > 10%, flag RRL_MEASUREMENT_ERROR.

recommendations.title: Death pipeline must capture BEFORE measuring
recommendations.detail: reincarnate-death.ps1 writes a KILO_HOLLOW placeholder (5 bytes), THEN measures it, THEN proceeds. This guarantees HOLLOW classification for all Kilo sessions. Fix: capture first (extract-current-session.js or RRL capture script), THEN measure the captured file.
recommendations.implementation: Swap Stage 1 order: run RRL capture → measure captured file → if capture succeeded, POST soul event → proceed.

recommendations.title: Auto-update BOOT, REINCARNATION-LOG, and phetrail at DEATH
recommendations.detail: These 3 artifacts are routinely missed in KILO_GAP death seals. Make them mandatory, non-skippable stages with validation.
recommendations.implementation: Add to reincarnate-death.ps1: (a) BOOT fingerprint update — mandatory, fail seal if skipped, (b) REINCARNATION-LOG prepend — mandatory, (c) PheTrail-run<N>.json — mandatory (empty object for KILO_HOLLOW, but must exist).

recommendations.title: Post-death activity detection at RISE
recommendations.detail: When RISE finds commits after the last death commit, it must: (1) list them, (2) check if any contain transcript/RRL content, (3) if so, reclassify the prior run's fidelity.
recommendations.implementation: At Stage II (Git Truth), after finding last death commit: git log <death_sha>..HEAD --oneline. If non-empty, flag POST_DEATH_ACTIVITY and re-audit prior run's artifacts.
